scenario: Two distinct TTL schemas have independent deadlines — a fast-expiring fact gone while a slower one survives the same advance: each fact expires via its own schema's TTL (LFAC.1.3.3) at its own deadline (RARC.5.2.4). Named for the LFAC.1.2 heading (`logical` facts), which it does not test.
rules_ds:
schema Fast scope ttl 100_ms:
    v: Int

schema Slow scope ttl 1_s:
    v: Int
